title: Founder story, diary page
description: Why we built it, written like a diary page: the frustration, the insight, the product.
prompt: Open on the exact moment that started it, as a handwritten line. Scribble the frustration, circle the insight in blue, then draw an arrow to the product on a real screenshot. Use only what the About page or a founder post says, first person, no hero talk. End with a human call to action.
